items.body:
<details open>

common: pin model resolution on real HF repo layouts (#30548)

* tests: pin model resolution on real repo listings

Extend test-model-resolution with 63 repo listings captured verbatim
from the HF API, chosen to cover every file naming pattern found across
1237 GGUF repos of the major publishers and pruned to whole quant groups.
Each repo pins its resolved plans and its cache listing.

The expectations follow what each file really is per its GGUF header,
not what the current resolver picks, so a mismatch is a resolution bug.
Mismatches are collected and reported together before the test fails.

* tests: leave the listing unchecked on paths the filesystem refuses

Some real split names (DevQuasar's Model.Q2_K.gguf-00001-of-00012.gguf
under a quant folder) exceed MAX_PATH once materialized in the temporary
cache on Windows, so the listing of such a repo is skipped with a note
while its plans stay checked.

* tests: pin real listings to master on GGUF convention names only

Replace the real repo table with 171 HF listings whose file names follow
the GGUF naming convention (lowercase sidecar prefix, - delimited
components, quant last), one per layout pattern found across 1174 GGUF
repos and pruned to whole quant groups. Repos outside the convention are
dropped. Each repo pins the plans and the cache listing master gives
today, so the test is a pure harness: any change in resolution shows up
here, and mismatches are reported together.

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

tests : refactor test-llama-archs to not link internal libllama symbols (#30880)

test-llama-archs included src/llama-arch.h and src/llama-model-saver.h,
which prevented building on Windows with shared libraries since the
used symbols are not exported from the DLL.

- declare llama_arch_* wrappers around the internal llm_ arch query
  functions in the llama-ext.h staging header, together with
  llama_arch_kv_name() and llama_arch_supports_save()
- slim llama_model_saver down to the private implementation of
  llama_model_save_to_file(): the fixture-writer half used by the test
  moves into tests/test-llama-archs.cpp as a local kv_writer
- replace the roundtrip saver usage with the public
  llama_model_save_to_file() writing to a temp path (also removes the
  tmpfile() fd leak and its Windows workaround)
- move test-llama-archs, test-generate-models, test-llama-context and
  test-fusion out of the NOT WIN32 OR NOT BUILD_SHARED_LIBS guard

Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF (2x DGX Spark (RDMA, TP=2))

</details>
